title: MemoryFrontmatter
description: Frontmatter schema for individual memory content files.

id.description: Unique identifier for the memory entry.

summary.description: Brief summary of the memory content.

sync_status.description: Current sync status of the memory entry.

evidence_mode.description: How the evidence for this memory was collected.

linked_commits.description: Commit hashes linked to this memory entry.

linked_specs.description: Spec identifiers linked to this memory entry.

linked_sessions.description: Session identifiers linked to this memory entry.

confidence.description: Confidence level of the memory content.

snapshot_id.description: Snapshot ID for pending entries awaiting reconciliation.

reconcile_after_commit.description: Commit hash after which this pending entry should be reconciled.

review_reason.description: Reason the entry was flagged for user review.
